object.title: Workflow reliability across interruptions and retries
object.description:
Implement the approved workflow reliability design through bounded changes to existing components. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-workflow-reliability-design.md. Preserve workspace/process safety, fresh admission/recovery, independent evidence and acceptance, finding continuity and truthful metrics. No replacement engine or mandatory six-state finding lifecycle. Root completes only when its acceptance obligations are met; super-auto owns finish.

## Global Constraints
- Extend existing components; preserve Workflow and ordinary-subagent paths and compact coordinator inputs.
- Concurrent roast-redesign run owns redesign triggers/amend and its ledger; reconcile the finding-continuity seam before implementation.
